text:
Priya: FYI customer hit a crash only in release builds on Android: NoSuchMethodError when Retrofit tries to create Moshi adapter. Debug builds fine. Suspect R8/proguard.
Jun: Classic. Moshi code-gen or kotlin-reflection can get stripped. Are you using moshi-kotlin-codegen (kapt) or the reflective adapter?
Priya: They're using moshi-kotlin-codegen. Crash trace points at com.example.sdk.internal.
Marco: Two frequent causes: 1) generated JsonAdapter classes being removed by minifier; 2) consumer-proguard-rules not packaged in AAR, so app-level R8 strips stuff. Repro steps?
Priya: I built the SDK AAR locally with minify disabled, added it to sample-app, enabled minifyEnabled true in app module and the crash reproduces on a release build running on Pixel 4 (API 30).
Katy: Quick check: does the generated adapter class have @Keep or a ProGuard rule? Moshi's codegen emits a companion - sometimes rules need -keep class com.example.sdk.**_JsonAdapter { *; }
Jun: Right. Also check that the AAR contains consumer-rules.pro under /META-INF. If our publishing step omits it, downstream apps won't get the keep rules. We should ensure our Gradle publishing includes consumerProguardFiles.
Priya: I inspected the published AAR and there's no consumer proguard file. Our pom has a packaging step but we missed consumer rules in the SDK module.
Marco: Short-term mitigation for the customer: add explicit rules in their app proguard-rules.pro, e.g.:
```
# keep moshi generated adapters
-keep class com.example.sdk.**_JsonAdapter { *; }
# keep model classes used by moshi
-keep class com.example.sdk.model.** { *; }
```
Also ensure keepattributes for annotation metadata: `-keepattributes RuntimeVisibleAnnotations,RuntimeInvisibleAnnotations` and for Kotlin metadata `-keepattributes KotlinMetadata` if using reflection.
Katy: Long-term SDK fix: package consumer proguard rules in the AAR and ship them. Example Gradle: `consumerProguardFiles 'consumer-rules.pro'` in the SDK module and publish. Add a unit test in CI that builds a release apk of the sample-app with SDK AAR and runs smoke-launch to catch the crash.
Jun: Another option: switch to publishing moshi-kotlin-codegen artifacts or add @Keep annotations via a Kotlin compiler plugin if we want to avoid proguard rules, but that is heavier. Also document the required proguard lines in our mobile onboarding guide.
Priya: I'll push a hotfix patch to the SDK publish pipeline to include consumer-rules.pro and send customer a temporary proguard snippet.
Devops-Bot: canary: triggered build sdk-0.16.1-rc1 including consumer-proguard patch.
Marco: Test matrix: add a CI lane that runs a sample-app release build with minifyEnabled=true on an emulator and runs a small instrumentation test to exercise JSON parsing. Fail build on NoSuchMethodError.
Katy: I'll update the onboarding doc and add a short FAQ entry: "Release build crashes due to Moshi adapters / R8" with repro and fixes.
Priya: Filed follow-up issue tracking publish pipeline fix, CI test, and docs. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
